intro.fr: Sonic Advance 2 se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Sonic Advance 2 can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub NiwatoriCode/sadv2_ap_releases, qui héberge l'APWorld de Sonic Advance 2.
text.en: The GitHub repository NiwatoriCode/sadv2_ap_releases, home of the Sonic Advance 2 APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version sadv2-v0.1.0, seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version sadv2-v0.1.0 is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Sonic Advance 2 figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Sonic Advance 2 is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
